SELECT DISTINCT category, subcategory, COUNT(*) as product_count
FROM dim_product
WHERE category ILIKE '%garden%' OR subcategory ILIKE '%garden%' OR product_name ILIKE '%garden%' OR category ILIKE '%furniture%'
GROUP BY category, subcategory

calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC, fiscal_period
LIMIT 20

SELECT 
  COALESCE(SUM(frl.quantity_returned), 0) as units_returned
FROM fact_return_line frl
JOIN dim_product dp ON frl.product_key = dp.product_key
JOIN dim_date dd ON frl.return_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE dp.category = 'Garden' 
  AND dp.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture'
  AND dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND dd.fiscal_period = 4

SELECT 
  dd.fiscal_year,
  dd.fiscal_period,
  dd.fiscal_period_label,
  COUNT(DISTINCT frl.return_line_id) as return_lines,
  SUM(frl.quantity_returned) as total_units_returned
FROM fact_return_line frl
JOIN dim_product dp ON frl.product_key = dp.product_key
JOIN dim_date dd ON frl.return_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE dp.category = 'Garden' 
  AND dp.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture'
  AND dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND dd.fiscal_period = 4
GROUP BY dd.fiscal_year, dd.fiscal_period, dd.fiscal_period_label

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  MIN(frl.return_date) as earliest_return,
  MAX(frl.return_date) as latest_return
FROM fact_return_line frl
JOIN dim_product dp ON frl.product_key = dp.product_key
WHERE dp.category = 'Garden' 
  AND dp.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture'
  AND frl.return_date BETWEEN '2026-08-03' AND '2026-08-30'
